stage: E3-1 all 22 E1 val images under fixed actual tool context
sample_selection: All 22 previously user-confirmed E1 val images, ordered by Arrow row; includes prior pilot3 and new19

reference.type: fresh greedy answer under identical fixed actual tool context

state_rule: last generate call, last decoding step, final layer, final position
candidate_policy: historical main LoRA; supplied canonical scene_classify call and one actual tool result; sample answer only
training_state_rule_difference: GRPO uses full-sequence forward including last sequence position; this pilot uses original offline rollout state shared with downstream evaluation
primary_utility: image-to-text reciprocal rank of best annotated positive among all unique exact raw val caption strings; strict greater rank from zero
secondary_utilities: best positive cosine minus highest negative cosine in the same unique caption gallery
E1 quantity pair cosine margin A
E1 quantity pair cosine margin B
text_gallery_order: Arrow row order, original per-row caption order, keep first occurrence of each exact raw string
positive_text_rule: all unique exact raw captions belonging to the target image; other unique strings negative under annotation protocol
utility_delta_reference: subtract own fresh greedy reference for each metric

tie_rules.spearman_cosine_margin: round to 6 decimals then average ranks

pair_statistics: all 28 candidate pairs per image; concordant, discordant, reward tie, utility tie, both tie counted separately; duplicates retained
repeat_check: regenerate seed 0 stochastic candidate once per image and compare tokens, state hash and tool events

tokenization: CLIP context_length=61; no truncation (fail explicitly if longer)

fixed_tool_protocol.action: scene_classify supplied in assistant context before generation; executed once per rollout
fixed_tool_protocol.tool_execution: actual frozen CLIP plus domain scene head, threshold 0.0; verify same result per image across candidates
fixed_tool_protocol.sampling: one answer generation call per rollout, min_new_tokens=1, max_new_tokens=64, temperature=1.0, seeds0to7
fixed_tool_protocol.resampling: none; retain every failure and duplicate
fixed_tool_protocol.model_generated_text: answer continuation only; fixed tool call and result saved as supplied context
fixed_tool_protocol.gate: 3 greedy references usable before any sampling
fixed_tool_protocol.quality: complete answer, nonempty, no addCriterion, no token limit and no additional tool request

full_analysis.primary: mean within-image concordance between r_retrieval and utility_rr among images with informative pairs; report image count and pooled pair ratio separately
secondary: within-image Spearman and top-reward utility regret

bootstrap.interval: percentile 2.5 and 97.5; omit undefined resamples and report count

full_analysis.groups: all22 primary; new19 and pilot3 separately
full_analysis.gate: rerun pilot3 greedy references first; other 19 greedy failures retained and flagged

text_feature_cache.policy: reuse feature vectors for exact known texts, including all 391 val texts; encode only new E1 quantity strings with the same frozen utility model
